records.source: If you dig in the dirt you can find some interesting things.#$e#One time I found a really old piece of pottery. I brought it to Gunther and he said it was over a thousand years old.
records.translation: Kung maghuhukay ka sa lupa, makakakita ka ng mga kawili-wiling bagay.#$e#Minsan ay nakakita ako ng napakatandang piraso ng palayok. Dinala ko iyon kay Gunther at sinabi niyang mahigit isang libong taong gulang na iyon.

records.source: I shouldn't complain so much about chores... some people in the world are really struggling, and here I am complaining about doing dishes...$s
records.translation: Hindi ako dapat magreklamo nang husto tungkol sa mga gawaing-bahay... may mga taong talagang naghihirap sa mundo, samantalang narito ako at nagrereklamo tungkol sa paghuhugas ng pinggan...$s

records.source: Dishes, dishes, dishes. Ugh... If my mother wasn't always nursing a headache from her late nights at the saloon, maybe she could help around the house a little.$s
records.translation: Pinggan, pinggan, pinggan. Ugh... Kung hindi laging may iniindang sakit ng ulo ang nanay ko dahil sa pagpupuyat niya sa saloon, baka makatulong siya nang kaunti sa bahay.$s

records.source: This is such a small town. You can't avoid meeting everyone.#$e#I wonder what it's like to live in the city?
records.translation: Napakaliit ng bayang ito. Hindi mo maiiwasang makilala ang lahat.#$e#Ano kaya ang pakiramdam ng manirahan sa lungsod?

records.source: $d Joja#Things changed a lot after the JojaMart went up. It's been really bad for Pierre's shop. Mom loves JojaMart, though. The prices are cheap, so she can afford a lot more there than she ever could at Pierre's.|Mom's been complaining ever since JojaMart closed down. I think it's good for her, though. Maybe she'll drink less Joja Cola now.
records.translation: $d Joja#Malaki ang ipinagbago ng lahat nang itayo ang JojaMart. Talagang nakasama iyon sa tindahan ni Pierre. Pero gustung-gusto ni Nanay ang JojaMart. Mura ang mga presyo, kaya mas marami siyang nabibili roon kaysa sa tindahan ni Pierre.|Laging nagrereklamo si Nanay mula nang magsara ang JojaMart. Pero sa tingin ko'y mabuti iyon para sa kaniya. Baka mas kaunti na ang maiinom niyang Joja Cola.

records.source: Hello. Ummm...$u#$b#The weather's interesting today, don't you think?#$e#Sorry...$u
records.translation: Kumusta. Ummm...$u#$b#Kawili-wili ang panahon ngayon, hindi ba?#$e#Paumanhin...$u

records.source: I've been trying to keep our place clean, but it always gets messy again.$s#$e#It's hard to run a household all by yourself.$u
records.translation: Sinisikap kong panatilihing malinis ang tirahan namin, pero lagi itong nagugulo ulit.$s#$e#Mahirap magpatakbo ng sambahayan nang mag-isa.$u

records.source: Oh no?$l#$b#Well, I guess that makes sense... you're busy with other things right now.
records.translation: Oh, ayaw mo?$l#$b#Siguro ay may katuturan iyon... abala ka sa ibang bagay ngayon.

records.source: ... Me too. I'm glad you feel that way.$7
records.translation: ... Ako rin. Natutuwa akong ganoon ang nararamdaman mo.$7

records.source: Yes... the urge to care for something innocent and helpless. It makes sense that we'd feel that.
records.translation: Oo... ang pagnanais na alagaan ang isang walang-malay at walang-laban. Makatuwiran lang na maramdaman natin iyon.

records.source: Oh, really?$s#$b# I think you'd make a good parent.$7
records.translation: Oh, talaga?$s#$b# Sa tingin ko'y magiging mabuti kang magulang.$7

records.source: hmm...$s#$b#If everyone thought like that, humans would die out.$s
records.translation: hmm...$s#$b#Kung ganoon mag-isip ang lahat, mauubos ang mga tao.$s

records.source: Oh...$s#$b#That's kind of sad... but I guess I can understand your point.$s
records.translation: Oh...$s#$b#Medyo malungkot iyon... pero nauunawaan ko naman ang punto mo.$s

records.source: Great!$h#$b#Let me just call the children over.
records.translation: Ayos!$h#$b#Tatawagin ko lang ang mga bata.

records.source: Really?... Uh... Well, alright. I guess I'll see you later then.%fork$s
records.translation: Talaga?... Uh... Sige. Siguro ay magkita na lang tayo mamaya.%fork$s

records.source: Thank you...$l#$b#I just wish George wasn't so upset... I was only trying to help.$s
records.translation: Salamat...$l#$b#Sana lang ay hindi masyadong sumama ang loob ni George... Sinisikap ko lang namang tumulong.$s

records.source: Oh... I guess you're right.$l#$b#I'm sorry, Mr. Mullner. It was rude, what I did.$s
records.translation: Oh... Siguro ay tama ka.$l#$b#Paumanhin, G. Mullner. Bastos ang ginawa ko.$s

records.source: I see.
records.translation: Nauunawaan ko.

records.source: I guess you're right... why stress out about something you can't change?$u
records.translation: Siguro ay tama ka... bakit magpapakabalisa sa isang bagay na hindi mo mababago?$u

records.source: You're right, we shouldn't ignore the reality of aging.$u#$b#I guess the sooner we come to terms with our mortality, the more time we can spend really living in the here-and-now.$u
records.translation: Tama ka, hindi natin dapat balewalain ang realidad ng pagtanda.$u#$b#Siguro, habang mas maaga nating tinatanggap ang sarili nating kamatayan, mas marami tayong panahong tunay na mabuhay sa kasalukuyan.$u

records.source: That's nice of you to say... I totally agree with you.#$b#We should treat our elders with the same respect we hope to receive ourselves some day.
records.translation: Napakabuti mong sabihin iyon... Lubos akong sang-ayon sa iyo.#$b#Dapat nating pakitunguhan ang mga nakatatanda nang may paggalang na inaasam nating matanggap balang araw.

records.source: That's a horrible thing to say. Life is a precious thing to waste like that!$a
records.translation: Napakasamang sabihin niyan. Napakahalaga ng buhay upang sayangin nang ganoon!$a

records.source: You really mean it? Thank you! ... it's such a relief to hear that.$h#$b#I've been working so hard on this recipe, and I'm really proud of it.
records.translation: Talaga bang sinasabi mo iyan? Salamat! ... Napakalaking ginhawang marinig iyon.$h#$b#Pinaghirapan ko nang husto ang resipeng ito, at talagang ipinagmamalaki ko ito.

records.source: Oh... Uh, sure.$s
records.translation: Oh... Uh, sige.$s

records.source: Oh...I'm sorry.$s
records.translation: Oh...Paumanhin.$s

records.source: That's right...$8
records.translation: Tama...$8

records.source: Really? I thought you'd have noticed by now...$8
records.translation: Talaga? Akala ko ay napansin mo na...$8

records.source: No!$9
records.translation: Hindi!$9

records.source: ...Oh, @. I thought you did, but I wasn't sure.$6#$b#...I'll always remember this night.$6^You look so beautiful tonight... I... *gasp*$6
records.translation: ...Oh, @. Akala ko ay ganoon nga, pero hindi ako sigurado.$6#$b#...Lagi kong maaalala ang gabing ito.$6^Napakaganda mo ngayong gabi... Ako... *Napasinghap*$6

records.source: Me too.$h
records.translation: Ako rin.$h

records.source: ...sorry.$s
records.translation: ...paumanhin.$s

records.source: I see.$s
records.translation: Nauunawaan ko.$s

records.source: Hi... Um, nice weather, isn't it?
records.translation: Kumusta... Um, maganda ang panahon, hindi ba?

records.source: $d cc#Thanks for fixing the community center back up. I guess you're kind of a town hero.|Hello, @. It's nice to see you're doing well.
records.translation: $d cc#Salamat sa pagsasaayos ng Sentro ng Komunidad. Para kang bayani ng bayan.|Kumusta, @. Ikinagagalak kong makitang maayos ang lagay mo.

records.source: $d bus#I heard you were responsible for fixing the bus back up. Thank you.|My mother used to drive the bus to Calico Desert... but the bus stopped working a few years ago. Mayor says there's not enough money in the town coffers, or else he'd have it fixed.$u
records.translation: $d bus#Narinig kong ikaw ang dahilan kung bakit naayos ang bus. Salamat.|Dati ay minamaneho ng nanay ko ang bus papuntang Disyerto ng Calico... pero tumigil itong gumana ilang taon na ang nakalipas. Sabi ng Alkalde ay walang sapat na pera sa kaban ng bayan, kung hindi ay ipinagawa na niya iyon.$u

records.source: So... do you like to decorate your farm house?#$e#It must be nice having your own place to decorate.
records.translation: Ah... gusto mo bang palamutian ang Bahay-Bukid mo?#$e#Siguradong masarap magkaroon ng sariling lugar na mapalalamutian.

records.source: Hello. Ummm...$u#$b#The mountains look nice today, don't they?$u
records.translation: Kumusta. Ummm...$u#$b#Maganda ang mga bundok ngayon, hindi ba?$u

records.source: Hi... Um, are you doing okay?$u
records.translation: Kumusta... Um, ayos ka lang ba?$u

records.source: It's kind of embarrassing to be the only family in town who lives in a trailer.$u#$e#I wish I could live in a nice house, someday.$s
records.translation: Medyo nakahihiyang kami lang ang pamilyang nakatira sa treyler sa buong bayan.$u#$e#Sana ay makatira ako sa isang magandang bahay balang araw.$s

records.source: Your farm looks really pretty right now.$h
records.translation: Napakaganda ng bukid mo ngayon.$h

records.source: Mom doesn't take very good care of herself...$u#$e#I worry about her.$u
records.translation: Hindi gaanong inaalagaan ni Nanay ang sarili niya...$u#$e#Nag-aalala ako sa kaniya.$u

records.source: Fall is a sad time of year for me...$s
records.translation: Malungkot na panahon ng taon ang taglagas para sa akin...$s

records.source: When I was a little girl, my father abandoned us because he said he felt 'trapped'. We haven't seen him since.$s#$b#I'm sorry to make things uncomfortable for you... It's just that this time of year makes me think of it for some reason.$u#$e#Anyway... How's the farming life going?
records.translation: Noong bata pa ako, iniwan kami ng tatay ko dahil sinabi niyang pakiramdam niya ay “nakakulong” siya. Hindi na namin siya nakita mula noon.$s#$b#Paumanhin kung inilalagay kita sa alanganin... Hindi ko alam kung bakit, pero naaalala ko iyon sa ganitong panahon ng taon.$u#$e#Gayunman... Kumusta ang buhay sa pagsasaka?

records.source: @! I was just thinking about the future...#$e#Where do you picture yourself in ten years?$l#$e#I have a few ideas for myself...$u
records.translation: @! Iniisip ko lang ang hinaharap...#$e#Saan mo nakikita ang sarili mo pagkalipas ng sampung taon?$l#$e#May ilan akong ideya para sa sarili ko...$u

records.source: Hi @.$h#$e#Your farmhouse must be pretty easy to clean, huh?
records.translation: Kumusta, @.$h#$e#Siguradong madali lang linisin ang Bahay-Bukid mo, ano?

records.source: ...yes?$u

Are you friends with Linus? He lives in a tent up in the mountains.#$e#Everyone ignores him, the poor guy. He's actually really nice... Just a little odd.#$e#It must be so cold to live in a tent this time of year.
records.translation: Kaibigan mo ba si Linus? Nakatira siya sa isang tolda sa kabundukan.#$e#Walang pumapansin sa kaniya, kawawa naman. Talagang napakabait niya... Medyo kakatwa lang.#$e#Siguradong napakalamig tumira sa tolda sa ganitong panahon ng taon.

records.source: I'm looking forward to seeing what your farm looks like in the spring.#$e#It's going to be so fresh and beautiful.$h
records.translation: Inaasam kong makita ang magiging hitsura ng bukid mo sa tagsibol.#$e#Magiging napakasigla at maganda iyon.$h

records.source: I try to stay indoors as much as possible during the winter. I hate being cold.
records.translation: Sinisikap kong manatili sa loob hangga't maaari tuwing taglamig. Ayaw kong nilalamig.

records.source: Oh... hi. You want to talk?$u#$e#If you find any interesting artifacts or minerals, Gunther will gladly display them in the museum.#$e#He told me he has special gifts for people who donate.
records.translation: Oh... kumusta. Gusto mong makipag-usap?$u#$e#Kung makakita ka ng anumang kawili-wiling artepakto o mineral, malugod na itatanghal ni Gunther ang mga iyon sa Museo.#$e#Sinabi niyang may mga espesyal siyang regalo para sa mga nagbibigay ng donasyon.

records.source: On the 25th we'll be having the Feast of the Winter Star. It's one of my favorite events.#$e#It's supposed to be a time to show gratitude for all the good things in your life... but for most people it's just a time to relax and exchange gifts.
records.translation: Sa ika-25 ay gaganapin natin ang Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig. Isa iyon sa mga paborito kong pagdiriwang.#$e#Panahon daw iyon upang magpasalamat para sa lahat ng mabubuting bagay sa buhay mo... pero para sa karamihan ay panahon lang iyon upang magpahinga at magpalitan ng mga regalo.
